candidates.prompt: Instrumental underscore for a premium cinematic data documentary about Manchester United history. Begin with controlled forward motion, make three increasingly weighty fact landings, then strip back into late-pressure negative space and a precise release. End unresolved so it can continue into the next act. No vocals, speech, choir, crowd, chants, commentary, whistles, football anthem, rock guitar, heroic brass, trailer braams, EDM drop, sentimental strings, or victory fanfare. 82 BPM, dark warm tonality. Restrained prepared-piano ticks, muted frame drum, warm sub pulse, bowed-wire harmonics, granular tape movement, dry close detail and deep stereo air. Minimal motif, asymmetric accents, emotionally exact, never grand.
